info.title: stability/edit-replace-background-and-relight
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "stability/edit-replace-background-and-relight", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Comfy Router request for Stability replace-background-and-relight, in Stability's edit fields sent as a JSON object. Keeps the subject of `subject_image`, replaces its background from `background_prompt` or `background_reference`, and relights it. One of `background_prompt` or `background_reference` is required, and `light_source_strength` needs `light_reference` or `light_source_direction`; both rules are enforced by the translator, not by this schema. Each image must be at least 64 pixels a side and at most 9,437,184 pixels in all; that is checked when the image is staged. Router submits the job and polls it to the end (`/proxy/stability/edit-replace-background-and-relight` answers `{"id"}`, and `GET .../jobs/{id}` answers 202 until it is done). Returns one PNG and is billed once, when the job succeeds.

example.background_prompt: a sunlit beach at golden hour

background_prompt.description: The new background. Required when `background_reference` is omitted.

background_reference.description: A Comfy-signed asset URL of an image the new background follows.

keep_original_background.description: `true` keeps elements of the original background. Default `false`. A string, as in Stability's form fields.

light_reference.description: A Comfy-signed asset URL of an image the lighting follows.

light_source_direction.description: Where the light comes from. `left` is not offered.

light_source_strength.description: How strong the light is. Needs `light_reference` or `light_source_direction`.

negative_prompt.description: What to keep out of the image.

original_background_depth.description: How closely the new background matches the subject's depth. Default 0.5.

preserve_original_subject.description: How exactly to keep the original subject. Default 0.6.

seed.description: 0 or omitted picks a random seed.

subject_image.description: A Comfy-signed asset URL of the image whose subject is kept.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for the Stability image models. The image is generated on Comfy-hosted infrastructure and stored on Comfy storage: `image` is a Comfy-signed URL valid for up to 24 hours, not a Stability URL, so download it before then. If the image cannot be stored, the call answers 502 and is not billed; no other URL is returned.

image.description: Comfy-signed URL of the (first) PNG image, valid for up to 24 hours.

images.description: SDXL only, when more than one image was returned. Every Comfy-signed image URL, in output order, each valid for up to 24 hours.

seed.description: The seed the image was generated with.
